violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw chicken wings were being stored above ready to eat General Tsos sauce in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS MUST BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF BACTERIA. PIC MOVED THE RAW CHICKEN BELOW THE GENERAL TSOS SAUCE IN THE WALK- IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: A knife and knife sharpener were being stored between the 3DR prep top unit and a prep top table, a location that can not be properly washed, rinsed and sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT UTENSILS SHOULD ONLY BE STORED IN PLACES THAT CAN BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC MOVED THE KNIFE AND THE KNIFE SHARPENER TO THE 3 VAT SINK TO BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED BEFORE BEING STORED IN A PROPER LOCATION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM PRESENT AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM SHOWED UP SHORTLY AFTER INSPECTION STARTED. EHS DISCUSSED GETTING MORE EMPLOYEES CERTIFIED AS CFMS WITH PIC.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. MULTIPLE BOXES OF FOOD ARE BEING STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS NEED TO BE STORED 6 INCHES OFF OF THE GROUND AT ALL TIMES. EHS DISCUSSED THAT PIC HAD 6 MONTHS TO ORGANIZE AND CORRECT THE ISSUE IN THE WALK-IN FREEZER.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Minced garlic in oil was temping at 68F. PIC told EHS that the oil is moved to a cart while they are cooking for easier access.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE IMPORTANCE OF MAKING SURE FOODS ARE BEING COLD HELD AT A PROPER TEMP OF 41F OR BELOW. PIC MOVED MINCED GARLIC IN OIL TO THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO COOL BACK TO 41F.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): shrimp tempera left on counter without written time control
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. CDI time written and discard after 4 hours
